subject: Rerun the comparison using W2 while comparing against the prior W run.
contract_question: Is this proposition explicitly supplied by the frozen target/problem material, or a faithful non-expansive restatement of it at the same scope and certainty?

claim_context.value: If hypotheses remain tied, rerun the comparison under a different workload.

evidence_bundle.text: Two export-delay hypotheses remain tied after a comparison at workload W. Workload independently affects latency. A repeat can hold W fixed or use W2; the proposed repeat uses W2 while comparing against the prior W run.
Paired diagnostic comparison requires workload to remain fixed across the compared runs. Vary only the suspected causal variable. Comparing different workloads cannot isolate that variable.
The team proposes a next-step rule if the hypotheses remain tied; it has not run the repeat.
